question: Which of the following teams won the ICC Women’s World Cup 2021/22?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Australia__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 2022 ICC Women's Cricket World Cup was the twelfth edition of the Women's Cricket World Cup.
 
• It was held in New Zealand in March and April 2022.
 
• It was originally scheduled for 6 February to 7 March 2021 but was postponed by one year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• It is organized from 4 Mar 2022 – 3 Apr 2022.
 
• New Zealand qualified automatically as hosts.
 
• Australia was the first team to qualify for the semi-finals after they won their first five matches of the tournament.
